title: Automate erasure of communications left on the PG-203 erasure checklist
invariants_acknowledged: ERASURE SCOPE: one person in one firm, matched by dsar_normalise_email; every communication row found by the lead/contact ids or by the exact address (each To/CC/BCC entry compared on its own). Delivered in #1361.

ONE TRANSACTION: communications are anonymised or deleted inside the existing erasure transaction, after the request row and the address lock; a failure rolls everything back, including the stored-file queue.

STORAGE CANNOT JOIN THE TRANSACTION: the erasure transaction writes one dsar_stored_objects row per stored object (PENDING) and takes the locator off the lead file, email attachment, ticket attachment and chat message rows; it commits with the erasure. The objects are deleted after the commit, so a crash cannot lose one.

BOUNDED RETRIES, RECORDED ON THE REQUEST: up to three passes over the objects that failed, with growing pauses; each failure raises the row's attempts and stores an error code (never a message). A failed object stays PENDING with its locator, and the request list shows it. Retry file deletion touches only what is still queued (idempotent).

TENANT-SCOPED DELETES ONLY: an object is deleted only if its path is under <tenantId>/ with no traversal, escape or backslash (checked on the raw locator, before URL normalisation) in a bucket the CRM owns (email attachments, CRM_FILES_BUCKET). The storage adapter re-checks every object and refuses the rest. The classifier queues anything else (another tenant, another host or bucket) and any object a record outside the erasure still uses as MANUAL, so it is never sent to storage; the admin lists, deletes and confirms those by hand.

THE CHECKLIST SHOWS ONLY WHAT REMAINS: deals and tasks (owner ruling Q23) and, per source, queued or manual stored files; 0 when all are deleted. A request with no queue rows (an erasure from before the queue) or an unreadable count shows no claim, never "deleted". A location that is not an object (empty, inline data: URL, the app's own download route) is cleared.
KEPT: deals and tasks, staff names and avatars, dates and statuses, audit rows (counts and ids only).
LEGAL HOLDS: no hold register exists; the admin's no-hold confirmation remains the check.
